onCreateCommand: install -m 600 <(printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY") .git/id && git config set core.sshCommand 'ssh -i .git/id -o IdentitiesOnly=yes'
postAttachCommand: read -p 'Clone SSH: ' remote_ssh_url && git remote add origin "$remote_ssh_url" && git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/HEAD
